backup.title: Backup
backup.text: Your projects are saved only in this browser. Download a backup now and then: it holds every project, with photos and progress, and your threads. To move to another device, restore it there.
backup.invalid: This file is not a $t(app.name) backup.
backup.persisted: The browser keeps your data safe even when space runs low.
backup.notPersisted: The browser may clear your data when space runs low.
backup.ios: On iPhone and iPad, add $t(app.name) to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen): Safari clears data of sites not used for a few weeks.

photo.drop: Drop a photo here, paste it, or pick one from your device.

crop.hint: Drag the box or its corners to choose the part to stitch.

adjust.denoiseHint: Softens photo grain and reduces isolated stitches.

toolHints.keep: Paint over the parts of the subject that went missing.
toolHints.remove: Paint over the background that's still there.
toolHints.wand: Tap the background: the area of similar colour around the tap goes. You can tap several spots.

adjust.outlineHint: A very dark grey line around the subject, handy when it's light on light fabric. You'll see it in the editor.

size.scrollFrame: scroll frame or move the hoop

colors.cleanupHint: Isolated stitches (confetti) make stitching slow: cleanup merges them into nearby colours.
colors.minStitchesHint: Colours with fewer stitches are merged into the most similar one.
colors.ditherHint: Mixes colours in dots to suggest gradients: more faithful, but more isolated stitches.
colors.threadsEmpty: Add the threads you own in “My threads” to use only those.

preview.empty: Choose a photo to see the preview.

errors.unsupported: This image can't be opened. Try a JPG or PNG photo.
errors.convert: The conversion failed. Try different settings.
errors.noThreads: No threads available with these settings.
errors.save: The project could not be saved.

editor.noActiveColor: Pick a colour in the palette

options.selectHint: Drag on the pattern to select.
options.cleanupHint: Brush over isolated stitches to merge them into nearby colours.
options.panHint: Drag to move the view; use two fingers or the wheel to zoom.

palette.empty: No colours yet: add one to start.
palette.deleteText_one: Its {{count}} stitch will be removed too.
palette.deleteText_other: Its {{count}} stitches will be removed too.
palette.symbolHint: Symbols used by other colours are not available.

resize.title: Canvas size
resize.hint: Add or remove space around the pattern.

text.title: Text
text.hint: The text is stitched in the active colour.
text.needColor: Pick a colour in the palette first.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Adds a very dark grey backstitch line along the edge you choose. Handy for light colours on light fabric.

realSize.title: Real size
realSize.saveFabric: Use this fabric in the project

viewHints.frame: The smallest standard frame that leaves at least 2 cm of fabric around the design.
viewHints.hoop: A {{hoop}} cm round hoop: if the design is larger, you see its centre.
viewHints.far: The finished piece as it will look from a few steps away.
viewHints.detail: Drag to move and use the wheel or two fingers to zoom: you can see every stitch and the fabric holes.

print.title: Print at real size
print.hint: A PDF of the stitched preview at 1:1 scale, to hang on the wall or try in a frame before you start.
print.ruler: This bar must measure exactly 5 cm.
print.instructions: Print at 100% (actual size), without “fit to page”. Join the sheets along the corner marks.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.heading: $t(app.name) – shopping list: {{title}}
shopping.estimateNote: Skeins are an estimate (8 m, 6 strands) with a safety margin: buy the amount shown, perhaps one extra for the most used colours.
shopping.boughtHint: Adds these skeins to your threads
shopping.inventoryHint: Add the threads you already own in “My threads”: this list will show only what's missing.

key.title: Key
key.name: Name
key.partialNote: Pattern Keeper does not read partial stitches, backstitch and knots: use the full PDF for those.

export.title: Export the pattern
export.printHint: Cover with sizes, key with estimated skeins, and chart pages with a grid every 10 stitches.
export.pkHint: Grid, black symbols and an English key only: the layout the Pattern Keeper app can read. Half stitches, backstitch and knots stay in the full PDF.
export.overlap: Repeat two rows of the neighbouring pages in grey
export.pngHint: The whole chart in a single image, to share or keep as a preview.
export.oxsHint: Interchange format read by WinStitch, MacStitch, FlossCross, Pixel-Stitch, Embroiderly and other cross-stitch programs.
export.projectHint: The full project, with the original photo and your stitching progress: use it as a backup or to carry on on another device, where you open it with “Open a file”.
export.error: I couldn't create the file. Please try again.
export.imported: This pattern comes from another designer's PDF: out of respect for their work it can't be exported or shared.

support.nudge: Finding it useful? $t(app.name) is free and ad-free thanks to the people who support it.
support.title: Support Stitchino
support.intro: Stitchino is free, with no ads, no accounts and no limits, and it will stay that way. It is built in spare time: if you find it useful, here is how you can help.

linkHints.liberapay: Recurring donations with no platform fee.

support.shareText: Recommend it in your stitching group, on social media, or to whoever asks how you made your pattern.
support.feedbackText: A bug, a pattern that came out badly, a feature you miss: every report helps.
support.testText: Stitchers can help tune the thread estimate and test PDFs with Pattern Keeper: a small sample is enough.

doneColors.autoHint: The colour that stands out most from this pattern's threads

stitch.resetText: All marked stitches, parking marks and the daily history will be cleared. Right after, you can still bring them back with “Undo”.
stitch.resetNotice: The pattern changed size after you started stitching, so the marked stitches no longer line up: progress starts again from zero.
stitch.allColorsHint: All colours: pick one to stitch just that

tools.area: Mark an area of one colour

toolHints.mark: Tap or drag over the stitches you've done. Starting on a marked stitch clears the marks.
toolHints.area: Tap a stitch: the whole area of the same colour around it is marked.
toolHints.rect: Drag a rectangle: every stitch inside is marked.
toolHints.lines: Tap a backstitch line or a knot to mark it.
toolHints.park: Tap where you left the thread of the active colour; tap again to remove the mark.
toolHints.pan: Drag to move around. Zoom with two fingers or the mouse wheel.

hints.parkColor: First pick the colour of the thread to park.
hints.allDone: No stitches left to do in this colour: well done!

inventory.clearText: All your threads will be removed from this device. To keep them, export a CSV first.

importPdf.title: Import a PDF
importPdf.intro: Open a designer's PDF chart to stitch it in stitching mode: mark the stitches you've done, highlight a colour, follow your progress. It works with PDFs whose symbols are text, the ones that work with Pattern Keeper.
importPdf.drop: or drop it here. The file stays on your device.
importPdf.needsPassword: This PDF is protected by a password.

errors.unreadable: I can't open this file: it may not be a PDF, or it may be damaged.

privacy.title: Privacy and terms of use
data: There are no accounts, cookies, ads or trackers.
Photos, patterns, progress and threads stay in this device's browser and are never sent to a server: conversion and PDFs happen on the device.
The site is hosted on GitHub Pages: like any web server, GitHub may log technical visit data such as the IP address, for security and operation.
Donation links lead to outside sites, each with its own privacy policy.
To delete everything, delete your projects or clear the site's data in your browser settings.
terms: Stitchino is free software under the GPL-3.0 licence or later, provided as is, without warranty.
Use photos you have the rights to. Patterns you make from your own photos are yours.
PDFs from other designers that you import stay for your personal use: the app doesn't export or share them.
On-screen colours and thread estimates are approximations: check against a colour card and buy a little extra.
DMC and Anchor are trademarks of their respective owners. Stitchino uses colour numbers only as a reference and is not affiliated with the makers.
